# Growovo site

> Set the goal and guardrails. Growovo keeps growth work moving: it finds opportunities, prepares content, executes authorized actions, follows up replies, and records receipts and business outcomes separately. Routine work runs within its approved scope; new permissions, high-impact statements and irreversible commitments escalate.

Pages: / (Chinese landing: three verifiable promises, a worked demo of one successful delivery plus three gate-stopped runs, FAQ, 30-second zero-network verification, agent interfaces) · /en.html (English mirror of the same page, FAQ included) · /guides/launch-autopsy.html (Chinese guide: the launch autopsy as a layered-results lesson — 73 posts, 0 new stars, followers and conversion never measured; publication ≠ reach ≠ followers ≠ business outcome; the night bypassed Growovo's own ledger) · /guides/launch-autopsy.en.html (English translation of the same guide, same numbers and limits).

Canonical repo and full agent entry: https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo (see repo-root llms.txt for interfaces, promise discipline and launch autopsy). Synthetic demo proves loop structure only — never reach, conversion or business outcomes. Business execution level (AUTO/GATED/MANUAL) and technical first-run status are separate axes: Email can run unattended; X and Discord can execute through named owner-attested WebMonitor managed tabs (an operator-risk route, not platform permission); GitHub stays GATED. Sending is not a business outcome.

- [Replay a supervised offline batch and inspect each action receipt](https://roy-tong.github.io/Growovo/examples/controlled-run.en.html)
